remarks: 442 Main Avenue combines elegant design with exceptional functionality across four pristine levels. Step inside to an inviting foyer that opens to a spacious, remodeled family room complete with a full bath. The main level features stunning hardwood floors, a fully renovated eat-in kitchen with island seating and a bright breakfast nook, a warm living room with a gas fireplace, an oversized dining area, and access to a private deck. Upstairs, the impressive primary suite offers a cathedral ceiling, two walk-in closets, and a luxurious spa-like bath. An additional en-suite guest room enhances both comfort and convenience. The top-level loft is a showstopper, with soaring ceilings and a French Door interior balcony-providing endless possibilities as a home office, gym, studio, or media room. Additional highlights include an attached garage, a dedicated parking spot, and unbeatable location. Just seconds to the Merritt Parkway, I-95, Metro-North, shopping, and dining, this home truly puts everything at your fingertips. This turn-key property offers the space, style, and location you've been waiting for-don't miss the chance to make it yours!
